results.name: page loads with no console errors, one h1 and the spec's headline

hero: the question, the sub-question, the resolution and two calls to action

urgency strip: three figures, each with a source link that opens safely
three promises: Know, Grow and Without the time, each with a visual and three outcomes
four-part cycle: Part 1 by default, clicking and arrow keys switch the product frame
forms vs conversation: the headline and the six-row comparison
board view: sample-data badge, key insights and five tabs that each draw a chart
trust, proof and setup: four pillars, the decision flow, two cards and three steps
final call to action opens the briefing form
briefing form: accessible dialog, focus on the first field, Escape closes and returns focus
briefing form: empty submit shows every required error, focuses the first, sends nothing
briefing form: valid submission posts the lead, scores it and thanks the visitor
briefing form: bad email is rejected, and fixing it clears the error
briefing form: honeypot filled by a bot sends nothing but looks successful
briefing form: double click sends one lead only
briefing form: server error keeps the input, explains, and a retry succeeds
briefing form: network failure offers the fallback email
briefing form: with only an email configured it opens a filled-in email
briefing form: with no endpoint and no email it fails loudly, never silently
lead scoring favors business leaders over HR, and personal email scores lower
attribution survives a reload in the same session
